arxiv-2012-14282.title: Reply on ‘Comment on The relativistic Aharonov-Bohm-Coulomb system with position-dependent mass’
arxiv-2012-14282.creator: R. R. S. Oliveira, A. A. Araújo Filho, R. V. Maluf, C. A. S. Almeida
arxiv-2012-14282.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by R. R. S. Oliveira, A. A. Araújo Filho, R. V. Maluf, C. A. S. Almeida. It is shown that the results of our paper are correct, although the use of the chirality operator γ 5 = σ 1 \gamma_{5}=\sigma_{1} in the paper is not correct, as fairly the authors of the Comment stated.

arxiv-2108-06515.title: Focusing on Persons: Colorizing Old Images Learning from Modern Historical Movies Conference: Proceedings of the 29th ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 20–24, 2021; Virtual Event, China Proceedings of the 29th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’21), October 20–24, 2021
arxiv-2108-06515.creator: Xin Jin, Zhonglan Li, Ke Liu, Dongqing Zou, Xiaodong Li, Xingfan Zhu, Ziyin Zhou, Qilong Sun, Qingyu Liu
arxiv-2108-06515.description: Abstract . In industry, there exist plenty of scenarios where old gray photos need to be automatically colored, such as video sites and archives. In this paper, we present the HistoryNet focusing on historical person’s diverse high fidelity clothing colorization based on fine grained semantic understanding and prior.

arxiv-2203-07620.title: Innovations in trigger and data acquisition systems for next-generation physics facilities A Snowmass 2022 White Paper
arxiv-2203-07620.creator: Rainer Bartoldus, Catrin Bernius, David W. Miller
arxiv-2203-07620.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rainer Bartoldus, Catrin Bernius, David W. Miller. Data-intensive physics facilities are increasingly reliant on heterogeneous and large-scale data processing and computational systems in order to collect, distribute, process, filter, and analyze the ever increasing huge volumes of data being collected. Moreover, these tasks are often performed in hard real-time or quasi real-time processing pipelines that place extreme constraints on various parameters and design choices for those systems. Consequently, a large number and variety of challenges are faced to design, construct, and operate such facilities.

arxiv-2211-11352.title: Brief Announcement: Broadcasting Time in Dynamic Rooted Trees is Linear
arxiv-2211-11352.creator: Antoine El-Hayek, Monika Henzinger, Stefan Schmid
arxiv-2211-11352.description: Abstract We study the broadcast problem on dynamic networks with n n processes. The processes communicate in synchronous rounds along an arbitrary rooted tree. The sequence of trees is given by an adversary whose goal is to maximize the number of rounds until at least one process reaches all other processes.

arxiv-2501-17611.title: Searching for signatures of Fe II atomic processes in spectra of active galactic nuclei
arxiv-2501-17611.creator: Jelena Kovačević-Dojčinović, Ivan Dojčinović, Maša Lakićević, Luka Č. Popović
arxiv-2501-17611.description: Abstract Aims. We use a large sample of Type 1 active galactic nuclei (AGNs) spectra in order to investigate which atomic processes are responsible for some observed properties of the Fe II emission lines and how they are connected with macroscopic physical characteristics of AGN emission regions.

arxiv-2510-22789.title: Learning Neural Observer-Predictor Models for Limb-level Sampling-based Locomotion Planning
arxiv-2510-22789.creator: Abhijeet M. Kulkarni, Ioannis Poulakakis, Guoquan Huang
arxiv-2510-22789.description: Abstract Accurate full-body motion prediction is essential for the safe, autonomous navigation of legged robots, enabling critical capabilities like limb-level collision checking in cluttered environments. Simplified kinematic models often fail to capture the complex, closed-loop dynamics of the robot and its low-level controller, limiting their predictions to simple planar motion.

arxiv-2511-19698.title: Extending Andrews and Newman’s Refinement of the Crank–Mex Theorem
arxiv-2511-19698.creator: George Andrews and Brian Hopkins
arxiv-2511-19698.description: Abstract . The crank–mex theorem states that the number of integer partitions of n n with nonnegative crank equals the number with odd minimal excludant (mex). Andrews and M. Newman recently refined that result in terms of the number of parts greater than one.

Better screening for risk factors of insulin resistance in children and adolescents is warranted.

pmc-10638926.title: Nanodrugs Reprogram Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts and Normalize Tumor Vasculatures for Sequentially Enhancing Photodynamic Therapy of Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-10638926.creator: Bingyuan Fei, Zhanhao Mo, Jinghui Yang, Zheng Wang, Shuo Li
pmc-10638926.description: BackgroundThe failure of cancer photodynamic therapy (PDT) is largely ascribed to excessive stroma and defective vasculatures that restrain the photosensitizer permeation and the oxygen perfusion in tumors.Method and ResultsIn this study, a nanodrug that integrated the cancer-associated fibroblast (CAF) regulation with tumor vessel normalization was tailored to sequentially sensitize PDT.

pmc-12432652.title: Myocardial contrast echocardiography predicts major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events in the population after percutaneous coronary intervention—a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12432652.creator: Xun Wu, Libo Chen, Yuqi Yang
pmc-12432652.description: BackgroundExisting studies demonstrated that myocardial contrast echocardiography (MCE), which provides residual myocardial viability (MV) information, is an effective long-term prognostic tool. However, the specific prognostic value of microvascular perfusion (MVP) parameters detected by contemporary intravenous MCE (IV-MCE) remains to be fully elucidated.

pmc-12512600.title: Influence of CO2 substitution for N2 on the combustion characteristics and kinetics of oil shale under oxy-fuel conditions
pmc-12512600.creator: Qi Liu, Qing Wang, Zhichao Wang, Huishuang Di
pmc-12512600.description: Oxy-fuel combustion is recognized as a near-zero-emission technology and an effective route for large-scale CO2 capture. Using TGA-DSC-MS, this study performed non-isothermal combustion tests on Fushun and Changji oil shales in two atmospheres—21%O2/79%N2 and 21%O2/79%CO2—to systematically assess how replacing N2 with CO2 alters combustion behavior and kinetic parameters.

pmc-12579399.title: Comparative analysis of hydroxyapatite and zinc oxide nanoparticles for effective dentinal tubule occlusion in dentin hypersensitivity management: a profilometric and scanning electron microscopic investigation
pmc-12579399.creator: Mayar H. Hassaan, Nagah A. Rashad, Afaf A. El Sawa, Lubna M. Eldesouky, Aya S. Sedik
pmc-12579399.description: BackgroundThe objective of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of hydroxyapatite nanoparticles (HANPs) in comparison to zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) in occluding dentinal tubules (DTs). Managing dentin hypersensitivity (DH) and assessing the resilience of anti-hypersensitivity treatments present significant clinical challenges. Hence, it is imperative to explore the impact of NPs on DH treatment.

pmc-13146600.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1587 FACTORS OTHER THAN HYDROCEPHALUS ARE NEEDED TO EXPLAIN THE ASSOCIATION BETWEEN INTRAVENTRICULAR HEMORRHAGE AND GAIT DYSFUNCTION AND INCONTINENCE
pmc-13146600.creator: Spencer Maranto, Miranda Marion, Colin Speer, Elisha Jindal, Mahim Mahim, Stacie Demel, Rosalind Lai, Adnan Siddiqui, Carl Langefeld, Daniel Woo
pmc-13146600.description: Background and aimsIntraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) complicates approximately 40% of spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhages (ICH). We previously reported that IVH associates with long-term gait dysfunction and incontinence independent of severity. We evaluated MRI metrics of hydrocephalus for association with these outcomes.MethodsThe Recovery and Outcomes after Stroke (ROSE) study obtained diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) at presentation after ICH.

pmc-13220681.title: Clinical Efficacy and Safety of Dual Versus Single Antiplatelet Therapy in Lacunar Stroke
pmc-13220681.creator: Sandhya Manorenj, Srikant Jawalkar
pmc-13220681.description: Introduction:Lacunar stroke, comprising 18% of ischemic stroke, is the second most common subtype of stroke in India. Available data on the effect of dual antiplatelet treatment with aspirin plus clopidogrel versus single antiplatelet therapy with aspirin alone, and their doses in lacunar stroke, are very limited.

pmc-13361494.title: “It’s All My Fault”: A Qualitative Case Study of Self-Disgust in Women with Gynecological Malignancies
pmc-13361494.creator: Rong-Hui Wang, Qi Tang, Zhi-Yuan Wang, Na Li, Xin-Ru Liu, Long-Hui Xu, Bei-Bei Dai, Cui-Ping Xu
pmc-13361494.description: ObjectiveTo explore the psychological experience of self-disgust among patients with gynecological malignancies, providing a basis for developing targeted psychological care plans.MethodsUsing purposive sampling, a descriptive qualitative study was conducted with 15 patients with gynecological malignancies admitted to the gynecology departments of two hospitals in Shandong Province, China, between May and August 2025.

pmc-13384136.title: Diverse origin and nature of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes: the infection hypothesis
pmc-13384136.creator: Candelaria Gomez-Manzano, Dong Ho Shin, Christopher Alvarez-Breckenridge, Andrew G Gillard, Golnaz Morad, Vinay K Puduvalli, Marta M Alonso, Frederick F Lang, Juan Fueyo
pmc-13384136.description: In the 19th century, Rudolf Virchow observed lymphocyte infiltration in tumors and suggested a potential link between cancer and inflammation. Current explanations for the origin of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes are based on the interaction between cancer cells and the immune system.

pmc-13457128.title: A protocol for the impact of Tongmai Jiangtang capsules on the risk of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events in metabolic syndrome
pmc-13457128.creator: Anxiang Li, Yuntao Ma, Zhuhong Chen, Qiyun Lu, Chaolan Liu, Peng Zhou, Qingshun Liang, Yiming Tao, Meilin Chen, Zihan Chen, Fan Luo, Xingxing Lei, Shulin Liu, Jieer Long, Hequn Xiao, Chongsong Cui, Qiqi Ren, Yunwei Liu, Tuoling Zhong, Jiamiao Liu, Guanjie Fan, Ya Liu, Zhenliang Hui, Qiu Chen, Zhenji
pmc-13457128.description: BackgroundMetabolic syndrome (MetS) significantly increases the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), yet evidence-based complementary therapies remain limited. Tongmai Jiangtang Capsule (TJC), a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) compound, has demonstrated benefits for glycolipid metabolism and microvascular complications, but its effect on hard cardiovascular and cerebrovascular (CCV) endpoints remains unconfirmed.

pmc-13495074.title: Microbiologic Patterns Found in Periprosthetic Joint Infections Following Total Joint Arthroplasty Differ Across Race and Sex
pmc-13495074.creator: Pranit Kumaran, Julian Wier, Sahil S. Telang, Natalie M. Kistler, Jay R. Lieberman, Nathanael D. Heckmann
pmc-13495074.description: BackgroundDespite extensive evidence demonstrating race- and sex-based disparities in periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) incidence following total joint arthroplasty, there is a lack of evidence on differences in the microbial profiles of pathogens identified. Our study evaluated the race- and sex-based differential microbial patterns of infecting organisms among patients with PJI.

pmc-13556362.title: 717. Clinical trials, ethical dimensions, and the pathway of MDMA-assisted therapy in PTSD
pmc-13556362.creator: C Poppe, D Repantis
pmc-13556362.description: BackgroundMDMA-assisted therapy (MDMA-AT) has shown promise for treatment-resistant post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), leveraging unique affective effects such as enhanced trust, empathy, and social connectedness. Despite preliminary efficacy, ethical challenges in clinical trials may directly affect regulatory approval and future clinical implementation.

pmc-13568271.title: Architecture-Level Event-Oriented Frontend for Heterogeneous Sensor Inference in Photonic Stochastic Systems
pmc-13568271.creator: Oleg Angelsky, Myroslav Strynadko, Claudia Zenkova, Roman Zaiats, Xinzheng Zhang, Jun Zheng, Jingxian Cai
pmc-13568271.description: Highlights What are the main findings? An architecture-level event-oriented frontend was developed to convert heterogeneous sensor measurements into unified event-oriented probabilities and polarization-compatible Bernoulli optical bitstreams for photonic stochastic processing.Reliability-aware weighting, stochastic stream decorrelation, and time-varying synchronization control were identified as key design factors governing event-inference accuracy, robustness, and scaling behavior.

pmc-13672725.title: Acquired hypothalamic obesity as α-MSH deficiency syndrome: a paradigm shift with therapeutic impact
pmc-13672725.creator: Martin Wabitsch, Kim Ulrich, Christian Denzer
pmc-13672725.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recent findings by Miller et al. (https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa2512275) suggest a fundamental shift in the understanding of acquired hypothalamic obesity (aHO), proposing that this condition should be viewed as an α-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH) deficiency syndrome. Building on these observations, we discuss the proposed underlying pathophysiological mechanisms and argue that aHO can be conceptualized as an injury-induced loss of melanocortin tone, analogous to an α-MSH deficiency.
